column1: # Anything not listed here is left at its default, so a NEW finding fails the
# job. An IGNORE is a decision with a reason, like the gitleaks allowlist and
# the licence gate: a scanner muted by a broad rule stops being a control.
# Baseline on 2026-10-04: 0 fails, 64 passes, 3 warnings, all three below.
# The six header findings that were here before are fixed rather than ignored,

column3: (Non-Storable Content) no-store on a case, a decision or a receipt is deliberate. This rule is the inverse of 10049's storable variant and fires because we refuse caching of customer data; /static and /openapi.json stay cacheable.

(CSP style-src unsafe-inline) the static UI that FE01 (#28) retires uses inline styles. script-src has no unsafe-inline, which is the directive that stops injected script. Revisit when the static UI goes.
(Modern Web Application) informational: ZAP noting the page is JavaScript-driven, which is not a finding.
